Unit Fifteen

# Media and Modes of E-communication

### Learning outcomes

After we have studied this unit, we will be able to
- surf the Internet
- read and write emails
- narrate incidents in a logical sequence
- understand texts
- read intensively and extensively
- participate in debates.
